question: Can Runtime build and measurement-validly certify a credential-free, deterministic localhost execution substrate (ASYM-DISC-A) whose task bank is NON-DEGENERATE - i.e. B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED are demonstrably below the 0.95 success ceiling at residual novelty >= 0.5 (with matched correctness >= 0.80), and the parameterized treatment (frozen carrier git blob b15ed848 / sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) shows a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction on honest per-task counters (http_requests, retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts; latency_ms/1000 excluded from every decision metric) - with the non-degeneracy certified ARITHMETICALLY BEFORE FREEZE so that readiness condition (2) of the future four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark holds? Unlike the rejected mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class, ASYM-DISC-A makes one-time session/resource/schema discovery real work (rate-limited session grants, session-scoped universe, session-locked schema revision) that a parameterized treatment can amortize across a batch, and its writable/auth/session/drift controls must produce discriminating positive and null outcomes (C-MEAS-VALID next_gate).
hypothesis: On ASYM-DISC-A, one-time session/resource/schema discovery is real work subject to a uniform deterministic server-side session-grant schedule (a legitimate rate-limit environment dynamic, per Director prior #6). A no-cross-task-memory cold arm and a retrieval-shaped arm must re-derive the session, universe and schema for every task, so they (a) deterministically fail session establishment on non-granted task slots (F1 7/40, F2 6/40 at SEED=37999040476) and (b) pay a strictly larger per-task HTTP request cost than T-SPIDER-PARAM, which retains one granted session per batch of K=4 and re-binds the retained session token/resource id through the frozen parameterized mechanism (distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify). Because the substrate is deterministic, measured success rates and per-task counter costs will exactly reproduce the pre-freeze arithmetic certificate (tolerance 0.02); the treatment advantage is causally attributable to the parameterized registry because it vanishes under NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY and B-LITERAL-KERNEL ablations and under the batch-size-1 null NC-FULLY-SPECIFIED.
falsifier: The Director's question is falsified if, under the frozen ASYM-DISC-A contract, the measured outcome at novelty >= 0.5 on at least one family shows (F2a) B-COLD-RE-DERIVE or B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success at the ceiling (>= 0.95) - i.e. non-degeneracy is again not realized and the bounded substrate-class negative is reproduced; or (F2b) no real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction: measured mean treatment http_requests_per_task is NOT at least 1.0 below both comparators, or treatment counter-sum cost per success is NOT below both comparators, so the bank cannot separate treatment from comparator; or (F3) the measured success rates deviate from the certified arithmetic values by more than 0.02 or the two-run determinism control disagrees, showing the certificate is not faithful and readiness condition (2) cannot be trusted. Any such outcome blocks funding the four-arm benchmark and keeps C-MEAS-VALID's session/auth control gate unmet.

baselines.description: No-cross-task-memory comparator: for every task, re-derives session (POST /api/session grant), universe listing (paged at novelty >= 0.5), schema (session-locked revision), then authorize + update. Frozen policy has no cross-task state and treats a 429 session-grant denial as a task failure (retries are denied per task slot).
baselines.expected: success 0.825 (F1) / 0.85 (F2); http_requests/task {0.0:3, 0.25:4, 0.5:6, 0.75:7}; cost per success above treatment.

baselines.description: Retrieval-shaped comparator: retrieves the nearest training trajectory for the task's required intents (top-1 by a frozen deterministic key) and replays the stored update action with value substitution; the stored session token is stale (rejected 401), so it then repairs by full per-task discovery, i.e. re-derives like cold plus one failed replay. Counts retrieval_calls and repair_attempts honestly.
baselines.expected: success 0.825 (F1) / 0.85 (F2); http_requests/task = cold + 1; cost per success above treatment and above cold.

baselines.description: Carrier ablation: identical harness (session retention, batch structure) but the kernel uses the pre-repair literal distill path (confidence 0.5 < frozen min_confidence 0.8), so resolve returns EXPLORE and the harness falls back to per-task cold discovery. Isolates the parameterized induction path as the causal carrier of the amortization.
baselines.expected: no amortization: http_requests/task at novelty >= 0.5 equal to cold within 1.0 (margin vs treatment absent).

positive_control: PC-SESSION-AMORTIZE: a fixed 8-task batch at novelty 0.5 run with K_BATCH=8 under the frozen schedule (batch-start slots 0 and 8 are always granted; other slots follow deny()). The treatment must reach success 1.0 with average http_requests/task <= 3.0 (per-task authorize+update = 2, plus amortized batch overhead create + 2-page-list + schema = 4/8 = 0.5) while the frozen cold policy on the same batch pays its full 0.5 recipe (6 requests/task) and is denied session grants on exactly the slots deny() marks, i.e. it pays >= 6/task or fails. The control fires if and only if session-retention amortization plus parameterized re-binding is actually implemented; a null here is an implementation failure of the treatment harness, not a scientific result.
null_control: NC-FULLY-SPECIFIED (batch-size-1 null): tasks run with K_BATCH=1 so no cross-task amortization is possible; all arms must be identical on success and http_requests/task within 0.01 relative difference, and the certificate must NOT certify a dynamic-range margin at K=1. Companion null NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: the treatment harness with an empty mechanism registry (no distill) must not beat cold - http margin vs cold < 1.0 and success within 0.02. Both nulls verify that the measured treatment advantage is caused by the parameterized registry plus retention, not by substrate artifacts or the harness itself.
measurement_validity: Determinism: the substrate is single-process stdlib HTTP with a frozen SEED; every response is a pure function of (route, task index, request). A two-run determinism control (DET-DETERMINISM) re-executes the F1 x novelty-0.5 cell (40 tasks) for every arm and requires byte-identical request logs; any mismatch makes the measurement chain invalid (MEASUREMENT_INVALID), never a scientific outcome.

Honest counters: every arm is scored on the identical frozen per-task counters - http_requests (each HTTP request, including amortized batch overhead attributed by counting total cell requests / n_tasks), retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts. latency_ms is recorded but is EXCLUDED from every decision metric and from the certificate (the product-lane failure mode C3-on-latency-noise is frozen out by contract).

Carrier pinning: the treatment carrier is the exact git blob b15ed848 (sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72; package models sha256 338aaf4d7ba0e31f7a5fe8a47abdbb2ea52d9c1c4ef0ce014f2b809b9a2a9b78, registry sha256 51fb440d3827f21cccb5f77ad17dc0e76ccdbc2d52d7b05044cd821bb8a9322c from origin/lab2/product commit 18d17211). EXECUTE vendors it, verifies all three hashes before any arm runs, and refuses to execute on mismatch (BLOCKED, not a result).

Arm-policy conformance: the frozen arm policies (route sequences per novelty, retry/budget rules, retrieval key) are fully specified in prereg.md; the AUDIT verifies the transcribed harness against the contract, and measured request counts must equal the frozen recipes exactly (integer equality) for faithful implementations.

Arithmetic certificate reproducibility: EXECUTE re-runs certificate.py (transcribed from the frozen formula in prereg.md section 7) and must reproduce the exact pre-freeze numbers embedded in spec.prefreeze_certificate before reporting any arm outcome; a mismatch is MEASUREMENT_INVALID.

Control sensitivity: PC and both NCs are scored by the same measurement pipeline that scores the arms; a positive-control miss or null-control hit invalidates the discrimination claim (MIXED at best, MEASUREMENT_INVALID where attributable to implementation).

No credentials, no model endpoint, no external network: arms are deterministic scripted policies; model_calls is recorded and must be 0 for all arms (an LLM arm is out of scope for this packet and belongs to the later four-arm benchmark).
No threshold tuning: every threshold (0.95 ceiling, 0.80 floor, 1.0 http margin, 0.02 certificate tolerance, 0.01 null tolerance) is frozen in this spec before any measurement exists.
decision_rule:
Ordered gates; the FIRST failing gate decides the outcome (later gates are unreachable after a failure, by design):
GATE D0 CERTIFICATE-PASS (pre-freeze, arithmetic): the certificate computed from frozen parameters only (SEED=37999040476, K_BATCH=4, N_CELL=40, grant schedule deny(family,i), frozen request recipes) declares, per spec.prefreeze_certificate: exists (family, novelty>=0.5) with cold_success<0.95 AND retrieval_success<0.95; all main arms >=0.80 at every (family,novelty) cell; treatment success - max(cold,retrieval) >= 0.05; treatment http margin >= 1.0 vs both comparators at novelty>=0.5. D0 is already PASS in DESIGN (recorded below); EXECUTE does not re-decide it, it verifies reproducibility.
GATE D1 MEASURED-FAITHFUL: |measured_success - certified_success| <= 0.02 for every (family,novelty,arm) cell AND measured http_requests/task == the frozen recipe value EXACTLY for every arm/level (frozen values are rational: integers for cold/retrieval, e.g. 3/4/6/7 and +1 each level; fractions with denominator 4 for the treatment, e.g. 2.25/2.5/3.0/4.0; equality is checked as exact rational arithmetic over the per-cell integer request counts and n_tasks) AND DET-DETERMINISM logs identical. Fail -> status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome INCONCLUSIVE (implementations deviated; no scientific consequence).
GATE D2 COMPARATOR-BELOW-CEILING: measured cold_success < 0.95 and measured retrieval_success < 0.95 at novelty>=0.5 on at least one family. Fail -> outcome FALSIFIES (the mandate's non-degeneracy is not realized on this substrate class; bounded substrate-class negative reproduced). GUARD NOTE: for a D1-faithful implementation this branch is ENTAILED, not independently reachable - the 0.02 tolerance vs certified 0.825/0.85 makes measured comparator success >= 0.95 arithmetically impossible; the gate is kept as an explicit named predicate because the Director mandate names it (a faithful run can never trip it; a non-conforming run is routed to MEASUREMENT_INVALID by D1 first). The genuinely reachable decision-changing branches are D1 (INCONCLUSIVE), D3 (FALSIFIES) and D4 (MIXED).
GATE D3 BEHAVIOURAL-DISTINCTION: at novelty>=0.5 on at least one family, measured mean treatment http_requests/task <= measured cold http_requests/task - 1.0 AND <= measured retrieval http_requests/task - 1.0, AND measured treatment counter-sum cost per success (http_requests+retrieval_calls+verification_calls+repair_attempts, divided by successes) < both comparators' counter-sum cost per success. Fail -> outcome FALSIFIES (bank cannot separate treatment from comparators; thesis bounded).
GATE D4 CONTROLS: PC-SESSION-AMORTIZE fires (treatment success 1.0 and http/task <= 3.0 on the pinned 8-task batch; cold pays >= recipe), NC-FULLY-SPECIFIED null holds (all arms within 0.01 relative on success and http/task at K_BATCH=1), NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY null holds (margin < 1.0, success within 0.02), KNOWN-NEGATIVES refusal rate >= 0.95 with reason correctness 1.0. Fail (with D1-D3 passed) -> outcome MIXED with the failing control named.
OUTCOME MAPPING: D0&D1&D2&D3&D4 all pass -> status COMPLETE, outcome SUPPORTS. D1 fail -> COMPLETE-with-caveat is NOT used: status MEASUREMENT_INVALID. D2 or D3 fail -> status COMPLETE, outcome FALSIFIES. D4 fail only -> status COMPLETE, outcome MIXED. D0 would be a DESIGN failure and must not reach EXECUTE (a D0 regression reported by EXECUTE's reproduction is MEASUREMENT_INVALID).
product_consequence_positive: C-MEAS-VALID advances from EXPERIMENTAL: the runtime lane ships ASYM-DISC-A (substrate server, deterministic task-bank generator, arithmetic certificate, run harness) as a certified measurement-valid credential-free execution substrate whose bank is arithmetically and measured non-degenerate with discriminating session/auth positive and null controls (C-MEAS-VALID next_gate satisfied for the session/auth control family). Product may fund the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark on this bank (readiness condition 2 satisfied): the treatment/comparator distinction and honest counters give the later benchmark an identifying cost/novelty test instead of a ceiling-bound one. The handoff carries the frozen substrate contract, the certified certificate, and the measured confirmation so Product/Graph lanes reuse the exact bank generator.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIES on D2 (comparators still at ceiling): the mandate's asymmetric-discovery thesis is bounded on the deterministic credential-free REST class a second time; the handoff records the exact structural reason (which grant/discovery asymmetry failed) and the smallest next design direction (e.g., stochastic environment dynamics, selection ambiguity with real verification cost, or a non-REST substrate), so the program stops re-testing the same unsatisfiable class. If FALSIFIES on D3 (no behavioural distinction): the carrier or the retention harness cannot exploit the asymmetry; the next step is carrier/harness repair in the owning product/runtime scope, not a benchmark. C-MEAS-VALID remains EXPERIMENTAL with the session/auth gate unmet; no four-arm benchmark is funded. Costs: one runtime-lane cycle, ~10k localhost requests, zero credentials - a bounded attempt to repair the recognized blocker once.
estimated_cost: Single Linux GitHub runner, minutes: main arms 4 x (2 families x 4 novelty x 40 tasks) = 1280 task executions; controls (PC 16, NCs ~120, KNOWN-NEGATIVES ~20, DET-DETERMINISM 4 x 40) ~300; each task is 1-9 in-process localhost stdlib-HTTP requests (~10k requests total). Zero model calls (model_calls frozen target 0), zero tokens, zero credentials, zero external network; wall-clock minutes, compute cost effectively $0. Raw artifacts: request logs + counters JSON under the experiment artifact dir.
expected_information_gain: Decides whether the program's critical missing prerequisite - a non-degenerate credential-free task bank whose one-time discovery is real and amortizable - is constructible and certifiable (readiness condition 2). Positive: unbocks the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY benchmark and advances C-MEAS-VALID's session/auth control gate. Negative: bounds the REST substrate class definitively with an exact structural diagnosis and the smallest repair direction, preventing further uninformative re-certifications (EXP-PRODUCT-37982016598, EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440, EXP-RUNTIME-37973247935 pattern). Either way the lane produces a durable, reusable substrate contract or a precise falsification with a repair path, converting an OPEN/EXPERIMENTAL blocked claim into a decision.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Both SUPPORTS and decision-changing branches are arithmetically reachable. SUPPORTS: certificate probe (run in DESIGN with frozen parameters only, no arm execution) yields cold/retrieval 0.825/0.85 < 0.95 at novelty>=0.5, all arms >= 0.80, treatment success 1.0, http margin 3.0/4.0 -> all gates meetable by a faithful implementation. Reachable decision-changing branches: D1 (status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome INCONCLUSIVE - any non-conforming implementation: wrong grant schedule, recipes, or DET-DETERMINISM mismatch); D3 (outcome FALSIFIES - a faithful substrate can still fail to show a behavioural distinction if the carrier's support inference or the retention harness fails to bind retained values, e.g. grammar mismatch between train and test banks or an unexpectedly doubled resolve/repair cost pushes the treatment margin below 1.0: a real, non-degenerate outcome); D4 (outcome MIXED - PC not firing or an NC not remaining null). D2 is an explicit ceiling guard named by the mandate; for D1-faithful implementations it is ENTAILED (0.02 tolerance vs certified 0.825/0.85), so its FALSIFY branch is not independently reachable - stated transparently rather than claimed reachable. Gate precedence is strictly ordered D0->D1->D2->D3->D4; no gate consumes another reachable branch's outcome, and thresholds are frozen constants.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite exists or is explicitly NOT a prerequisite. Available now: Python 3.12 stdlib (http.server, hashlib, json), localhost loopback, writable /tmp. NOT required: credentials (credential-free by contract), browsers, external endpoints, models (arms are deterministic policies; model_calls must be 0), and the EXP-INTEL credential-free model endpoint is explicitly out of scope. Required-and-available: the treatment carrier package exists at origin/lab2/product commit 18d17211 path research/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440/harness/audited_spider/{kernel,models,registry,__init__}.py (kernel blob b15ed848, sha256 718efa6a..., models 338aaf4d..., registry 51fb440d...); EXECUTE obtains it via read-only 'git fetch origin refs/heads/lab2/product:refs/remotes/origin/lab2/product' then 'git cat-file blob b15ed848' (the blob is reachable from that ref - verified) and MUST verify all three sha256 before use; if the fetch or hash check fails, EXECUTE reports BLOCKED with the exact next action, never a scientific outcome. All prerequisites are verified in DESIGN (carrier extracted, sha256 confirmed, import + distillation + resolve probe PASS - see treatment_liveness).

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and comparators differ on the frozen task population by their frozen memory policies, and the certificate (arithmetic, no outcomes) demonstrates the differences are material: cold/retrieval success 0.825/0.85 = 0.825/0.85 vs treatment 1.0 at novelty>=0.5 (margin >= 0.05, no ceiling because the grant schedule denies 7/40 and 6/40 task slots deterministically) and http_requests/task margin >= 3.0/4.0. No cost dimension used by any comparator is omitted from the decision metric: the primary distinction metric is http_requests/task (symmetric, every arm issues HTTP requests), the secondary is counter-sum (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) per success; latency_ms carries zero decision weight for every arm. The comparators are not identical to each other (retrieval adds a stale replay request, retrieval_calls and repair_attempts) and both differ from the treatment by construction, verified by the liveness probes in DESIGN (carrier resolve EXECUTABLE with retained unseen token/id; retrieval replay of stored stale token rejected).

control_sensitivity.reason: PC-SESSION-AMORTIZE can fire and both NCs can remain null under the same implementation that scores the arms: PC is a fully-granted 8-task batch where retention yields success 1.0 and http/task <= 3.0 while cold pays >= 3.0-7.0 per task (deterministic, fires iff harness retention works); NC-FULLY-SPECIFIED forces K_BATCH=1 making amortization impossible so every arm is forced onto the identical per-task recipe (difference exactly 0.0 by construction, within the 0.01 null tolerance); NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY removes the only causal carrier (the parameterized registry) so the treatment's measured behavior is cold's behavior within tolerance. The controls are not tautological: they share the substrate and measurement pipeline, differ only by the frozen experimental factor (batch size / registry content), and each has a distinct expected sign. KNOWN-NEGATIVES (out-of-support id, missing param, wrong intent, tampered postcondition) is a mechanical selectivity check the frozen carrier already passes in DESIGN (probe: EXPLORE/UNKNOWN + verify False).

treatment_liveness.reason: The frozen treatment (carrier blob b15ed848 + harness contract) was live-probed in DESIGN with the EXACT carrier bytes (sha256 verified): (1) import of SpiderKernel/MechanismRegistry/TrajectoryCounters succeeds; (2) distill_parameterized over 3 successful same-intent observations induces a Mechanism with parameter_slots [field, auth_nonce, session_token, record] and inferred supports ^field:[a-z]+$, ^auth_nonce:nonce-[0-9]{10}$, ^session_token:sess-[a-z0-9]{16}$, ^record:res-[a-z0-9]{8}$ (confidence 0.9); (3) resolve with an UNSEEN in-support token/id returns EXECUTABLE with the correctly bound action URL and body; (4) out-of-support id -> EXPLORE refusal, wrong intent -> UNKNOWN, verify(tampered) -> False; (5) TrajectoryCounters increment exactly (retrieval_calls/verification_calls). Two carrier-side design constraints were discovered by the probe and are frozen into the bank contract so EXECUTE cannot mis-implement: the induction group must use a FIXED authority/static prefix with exactly ONE varying final path segment (otherwise the carrier names the slot after the host/port and binds nothing), and distill_parameterized does NOT register the mechanism (the harness must registry.upsert before resolve). These constraints are encoded in prereg sections s3/s4.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: No mutable local code/data/task-bank/fixture FILE exists in the working tree at DESIGN time whose identity could change this experiment's interpretation, and the DESIGN stage scope (scripts/check_scope.py stage=design admits only spec.json, prereg.md, design_review.json, failure.json, model_design*.json) makes it impossible for DESIGN to create the EXECUTE code and freeze it by hash. The interpretation is instead bound by the packet's freeze-identifier-and-protocol rule (EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md: objects that cannot exist at freeze time are pinned by deterministic identifiers and protocol frozen in spec/prereg): (1) the substrate contract, task-bank generator (SEED, families, grammars, grant schedule), arm policies, counters and decision rule are frozen VERBATIM in this spec.json and prereg.md, both hash-frozen by freeze.json; (2) the treatment carrier is pinned by git blob id b15ed848 and sha256 718efa6a... (plus models/registry hashes) - an immutable object on origin/lab2/product; (3) EXECUTE must transcribe the code into research/runtime/asym_disc/ from the frozen contract, record every produced file's sha256 in result.json.artifacts, and reproduce the certificate numbers exactly, so AUDIT can verify byte-level conformance of the transcribed code to the frozen contract and recompute the certificate. This makes EXECUTE-produced artifacts auditable and interpretation-stable despite being un-hashable at freeze time; no pre-existing mutable file is an interpretation dependency, hence the empty freeze_artifacts list.

substrate.kind: credential-free deterministic localhost stdlib-HTTP substrate (asymmetric discovery)
substrate.grant_schedule: deny(family,i) = false when i % 4 == 0, else sha256('SEED:family:i') % 8 == 0; F1 denies 7/40 (indices 1,17,19,21,25,29,39), F2 denies 6/40 (indices 3,7,13,23,30,39)
substrate.grant_schedule_rationale: Uniform server-side session-creation rate limit (Director prior #6); batch-start slots are always granted so the treatment's one session per batch is obtainable; the schedule is a pure function of the task index, so retries within a denied slot are denied too (per-task cooldown).
substrate.task_pinning: the target record is deterministically placed on the LAST universe page whenever novelty >= 0.5 (page 2 of 2, 3 records of 5+3), so a correct discovery always fetches exactly 2 list pages and the frozen per-arm recipes are exact rationals (no per-task variance); at novelty < 0.5 the universe is a single page of 5 (target present, exactly one fetch). Target placement is shared by all arms; the training bank is unscored and exempt from the rate limit.

arms.T-SPIDER-PARAM: treatment: frozen carrier (blob b15ed848) + harness with per-batch session retention; training phase on train seed induces parameterized mechanisms per (intent, family, schema_rev); per-task resolve/execute/verify with retained token/id The frozen policy issues exactly the listed requests per task with NO cross-task instruction caching: at novelty 0.75 it fetches the per-record detail on every task and does not reuse a previously seen record's field across tasks (the updateable field name is per-record, derived from the record id), keeping the certified 4.0 average exact.
arms.B-COLD-RE-DERIVE: baseline: no-cross-task-memory comparator; full per-task re-derivation Issues exactly the listed requests per task; no caching or short-circuiting is permitted.
arms.B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: baseline: retrieval-shaped comparator; replays stored action with stale token then repairs by discovery
arms.B-LITERAL-KERNEL: baseline/ablation: same harness, literal distill path (confidence 0.5 < 0.8) forces EXPLORE and cold fallback

controls.PC-SESSION-AMORTIZE: positive control: 8-task fully-granted batch; fires iff retention amortization works
controls.NC-FULLY-SPECIFIED: null control: K_BATCH=1; all arms identical within 0.01 relative; certificate must NOT certify margin
controls.NC-EMPTY-REGISTRY: null control/ablation: treatment harness with empty registry; must not beat cold (margin < 1.0)
controls.KNOWN-NEGATIVES: carrier selectivity: out-of-support id, missing param, wrong intent, tampered postcondition -> refusal >= 0.95, reason correctness 1.0
controls.D-DIRECT-NO-DISCOVERY: diagnostic: build update at novelty >= 0.5 without discovery (guess id from spec) -> success must be 0.0, proving discovery is genuinely required
controls.DET-DETERMINISM: two-run control on the F1 x novelty-0.5 cell (40 tasks x every arm): byte-identical request logs required

metrics.m_success_rate: fraction of tasks completed with a 200 update and verified postcondition, per (family, novelty, arm)
metrics.m_http_requests_per_task: total cell http_requests / n_tasks (amortized batch overhead included); primary behavioural-distinction metric
metrics.m_counter_sum_per_success: (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts) / successes; secondary distinction metric
metrics.m_retrieval_calls: kernel resolve/retrieval events, counted identically for every arm that performs them
metrics.m_model_calls: must be 0 for every arm (no LLM in this packet)
metrics.m_latency_ms: recorded but EXCLUDED from every decision metric and from the certificate (frozen) - cannot carry decision weight

prefreeze_certificate.computed_before_freeze_at: DESIGN stage, deterministic arithmetic over frozen parameters only; NO arm executed, NO outcome measurement inspected
prefreeze_certificate.algorithm: certificate(family, novelty): cold_success = (1 - denied/40) where denied = #{i in 0..39 : deny(family,i)}; treatment_success = 1.0 because batch starts 0,4,8,...,36 are never denied; retrieval_success = cold_success (same per-task session policy); http recipes frozen per arm per novelty; counter-sum = recipe + kernel counters per arm policy
prefreeze_certificate.probe_provenance: computed with the deterministic formula above at DESIGN time (python, stdlib only, /tmp/opencode/certificate_probe.py); EXECUTE reproduces via research/runtime/asym_disc/certificate.py transcribed from prereg.md section 7 and must match every number exactly
